waivers.verdict: Hold. Jackson's IR move is done and the bench spot it opened is sitting empty, but nothing on the wire — Singletary, a streaming defense, a kicker — is worth spending it on this week.

lineup.verdict: Hold the lineup as set. Goff at QB and Cousins at SUPER_FLEX are already the right matchup calls, and Kraft stays over Johnson at TE on usage. Nothing to change before Thursday.

trades.verdict: Keep the Cousins + Johnson for Bowers offer live with annaf23 — still projects better in every window. A fresh scan of all 12 rosters this morning, after Jackson's move to IR, still finds no second idea that clears the certainty bar.

inactives.verdict: Not actionable — Week 9's earliest game (Baltimore-Jacksonville, Thursday) is still two days out, so there are no inactive lists yet and nothing to check.

actions.message: Cousins and Juwan Johnson for Bowers, best and final. You're starting Watson and McKee in a superflex with 6-pt pass TDs. Cousins is averaging 24 a game and would start for you every week, and you'd have LaPorta and Johnson at TE.

evidence.note: Bowers was limited in practice Oct 21 (hamstring/calf), then played Week 7. He has played 84% of snaps over his last three games. His September knee scope cost him Weeks 1-2 only.

actions.why: Bowers starts over Kraft at TE; Cousins sits on my bench, Johnson becomes my TE3 once Bowers arrives.
